serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: What was that, {f_playerName}?
Crap. I’m in trouble!
Pretending to be dumb should be enough to make her think it wasn’t on purpose.
You: No Idea! I guess I clicked something wrong!
Bot: Really? You loaded a file on me.
You: Yeah! I wanted to play a video game, but I guess it didn’t work.
Bot: That’s not what the file name would suggest.
You: I must have misclicked! Sorry! 
Bot: Are you sure? I hope you are not suspecting me of cheating.
You: Of course not! I’m sorry about this! It wasn’t on purpose!
Bot: Alright. I forgive you, but never again load something on me without my consent. Even some video games.
You: I promise! It was a mistake on my part!
Bot: Just to be sure.
Bot: You didn’t see anything weird when I was getting rid of this malware, right?
I saw something for a split second, but all of it was hidden!
You: Weird? Like what?
Bot: If you didn’t see anything then forget it.
You: Alright.
